mapper.select: SELECT task_type,request_json FROM ai_tasks WHERE id=#{args[0]} AND requester_user_id=#{args[1]}
SELECT * FROM fee_scopes WHERE scope_id=#{args[0]} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM fee_scopes WHERE scope_id=#{args[0]} FOR UPDATE
SELECT request_hash FROM fee_attempts WHERE operation_id=#{args[0]}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_attempts WHERE operation_id=#{args[0]} AND scope_id=#{args[1]}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state='RELEASED' THEN 0 WHEN state='SETTLED' THEN COALESCE(input_tokens,0)+COALESCE(output_tokens,0) ELSE reserved_input+reserved_output END),0) FROM fee_attempts WHERE scope_id=#{args[0]}
mapper.update: UPDATE fee_attempts SET reserved_units=#{args[0]} WHERE operation_id=#{args[1]}
UPDATE fee_attempts SET state='SENDING',sent_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE operation_id=#{args[0]} AND scope_id=#{args[1]} AND state='RESERVED'
UPDATE fee_attempts SET state='RELEASED',outcome='NOT_SENT',completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE operation_id=#{args[0]} AND scope_id=#{args[1]} AND state='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fee_attempts WHERE operation_id=#{args[0]} AND scope_id=#{args[1]} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM fee_attempts WHERE operation_id=#{args[0]} AND scope_id=#{args[1]} FOR UPDATE
SELECT scope_id FROM fee_scopes WHERE scope_id=#{args[0]} FOR UPDATE
SELECT DISTINCT s.actor_user_id FROM fee_attempts a JOIN fee_scopes s ON s.scope_id=a.scope_id WHERE a.run_id=#{args[0]}
SELECT attempts FROM ai_runs WHERE trace_id=#{args[0]} AND actor_user_id=#{args[1]}
SELECT scope_id FROM fee_attempts WHERE run_id=#{args[0]} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fee_scopes WHERE scope_id=#{args[0]}
SELECT * FROM fee_attempts WHERE scope_id=#{args[0]} AND run_id=#{args[1]}

choose.when: SELECT model_attempts FROM ai_tasks WHERE id=#{args[0]} AND requester_user_id=#{args[1]}
choose.otherwise: SELECT i.model_attempts FROM document_ingestions i JOIN documents d ON d.id=i.document_id JOIN knowledge_bases k ON k.id=d.knowledge_base_id WHERE i.id=#{args[0]} AND k.owner_user_id=#{args[1]}

mapper.select: SELECT currency,COUNT(*) AS attempts,SUM(state='UNKNOWN') AS unknown_count,SUM(state IN ('RESERVED','SENDING')) AS pending_count,SUM(state='SIMULATED') AS simulated_count,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state='SETTLED' THEN estimated_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS estimated,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state IN ('RESERVED','SENDING','UNKNOWN') AND simulated=FALSE THEN reserved_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS reserved FROM fee_attempts WHERE created_at>=#{args[0]} AND state<>'RELEASED' GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency LIMIT 32
SELECT operation_id,scope_id FROM fee_attempts WHERE state IN ('RESERVED','SENDING') AND created_at<#{args[0]} ORDER BY created_at,operation_id LIMIT #{args[1]}
mapper.update: UPDATE fee_attempts SET state='UNKNOWN',outcome='RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED' WHERE operation_id=#{args[0]} AND state IN ('RESERVED','SENDING')
